verdict.rationale: Unleash's own impact-metrics and release-management features let users define threshold rules that automatically advance milestones, or pause rollouts and disable environments, when metrics cross a threshold. That is a genuine rule-triggers-action capability, but it is limited to rollout safeguards driven by metric thresholds. It is not a general event-driven automation engine. Missing for 10: general-purpose event types and triggers beyond metric thresholds, a broader set of configurable actions, in-depth documentation of rule definition, independent or hands-on corroboration.
